'''Oln Pressig''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] around [[43 ABY]]. Achieving the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], Pressig became [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s day-shift Security Chief. However, in 43.5 ABY, Pressig came into league with the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Haydnat Treen]], who used him to set forth her plot to unseat Fel, unite the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] with the Empire, and then unseat Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and become [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Pressig headed an [[Kidnap attempt in the Galactic Empire Embassy Complex|attack]] with several other [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in an attempt to kidnap Fel in the Head of State's quarters in the [[Galactic Empire Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, Fel managed to fight off the troopers, [[Death/Legends|killing]] six of them, including Pressig.
